conclusion_zh: V4 总体盲评提高5分但严格检索完整事实由8/23降至5/23；最终V5总体盲评由74.0625降至71.40625（-2.65625，3胜4负1平），严格检索完整事实由9/23降至6/23，完全无关来源标签由7/64升至9/37。V5开发回归组下降6.875分，新问题组提高1.5625分但2胜2负，且包含OFF单题关键错误，不能据此宣称稳定改善。V5总token均值下降44.5815%、答案耗时均值下降31.4517%，属于效率收益，未通过回答质量与证据完整性放行。建议应用默认继续关闭，仅显式实验性启用。两轮36次调用共175412个provider报告token，8个独立主问题重复测量，不是16题泛化验证。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems

protocol.baseline: Within each frozen run, assistance OFF retains the legacy hybrid selector. Historical V3 or V4 responses are not substituted for a paired baseline.
protocol.treatment: Assistance ON changes bounded source selection using literal/locally translated facets and a local cross-encoder. This is evidence reselection, not formal reasoning, proof, or established entailment.
protocol.output_cap_scope: 8192 is an experiment-only override; product default remains 2048. The observed token counts and latency are not product-default-cap measurements.

development_regression.purpose: Previously exposed failure questions used as development regression checks.

new_question_no_tuning.purpose: Newly authored questions on the same four known papers, frozen before V4 generation and withheld from production-code implementers until freeze. Not an unseen-paper or held-out-corpus generalization test.

context_controls: Original pinned public PDFs only; no rubric facts, fabricated chains, scoring notes, or question-specific extracts indexed or provided to the answer model.
Each arm uses a new temporary project, fresh #00001 session and clone of the frozen parsed corpus; no conversation history, confirmed memory or response cache.

Document vectors are prepared separately for each fresh arm namespace before the answer timer; vectors are not treated as free or inherited across arms. Queries are freshly encoded inside the answer timer.
Same retrieval source budget, model, temperature, output cap and provider in both arms. Serial execution, alternating first arm; no automatic retry.
V5 reuses V4 pristine corpus parses and IDs; the saved V4 ingestion timestamps/costs are provenance, not newly incurred V5 ingestion work.

quality_method.blinding: Random-label packets hide arm, algorithm traces, usage and latency; actual supplied source excerpts and frozen scoring facts remain visible.
quality_method.weighting: Each main question has one generation per arm and equal weight. Agent ratings are descriptive and not statistical significance evidence.

measurement_definitions.answer_key_fact_coverage: Semantic status covered/partial/absent on the generated answer against each frozen required fact. Covered alone counts as complete. This is separate from weighted quality and supplied-evidence coverage.
measurement_definitions.retrieved_evidence: Judge only the exact supplied source pack: full requires every material subject, relation, attribution and condition in a compound fact; partial is not full. Correct facts remembered by the model do not count as retrieved evidence.
measurement_definitions.denominators: Per arm, development_regression has 11 required facts, new_question_no_tuning has 12, overall has 23. Micro rates pool those facts; macro rates average the 4 or 8 question-level fractions. Both are reported and must not be interchanged.
measurement_definitions.irrelevant_source_labels: Wholly irrelevant labels contribute neither requested support nor necessary qualifying context. Mixed labels are not wholly irrelevant. Micro rate sums labels; macro rate averages question-level fractions. These are not sentence-level precision or byte-level noise.
measurement_definitions.percentage_change: 100 * (on_mean / off_mean - 1); null when OFF mean is zero.
measurement_definitions.usage: Actual provider counts only; prompt/completion/total/cache/reasoning stay separate. Missing values are null and incomplete measured pairs do not receive an invented zero.
measurement_definitions.cache: Provider cached_tokens are a detail/subset of prompt usage, not additional tokens to add to total. Response caching is disabled but provider prompt caching remains observable; cache hits differ in 3/8 V4 pairs.
measurement_definitions.latency: Wall-clock pre-model, full non-streaming HTTP model call, post-model and total answer; not first-token latency. New runs exclude PDF ingestion, corpus cloning and document-vector prewarm from the answer timer and record them separately. Query encoding and retrieval remain inside the answer timer. Legacy missing setup measurements stay null.
measurement_definitions.setup: retrieval_setup_latency_ms measures document-vector prewarm in each fresh storage namespace; per_arm_setup_latency_ms adds that arm's corpus clone. upfront_setup_latency_ms additionally includes the shared, amortizable frozen-corpus ingestion cost. Its paired mean describes cold-start-equivalent cost, not total run expenditure: never sum upfront_setup_latency_ms across answers. corpus_ingestion retains each corpus once; setup is local work with real elapsed cost, not free provider tokens.
measurement_definitions.local_helper: ON result.reasoning.trace.total_ms is local extraction/translation/reranking/selection time included inside pre_model_latency_ms; OFF disabled helper timings remain unavailable rather than invented. These local models make no extra Step-5 provider calls.
measurement_definitions.model_vs_local: model_latency_ms is the measured full non-streaming Step-5 HTTP request, not a modeled estimate or TTFT. Local pre-model/helper/embedding measurements are wall-clock on this machine. upfront_setup_latency_ms is a cold-start-equivalent arithmetic allocation; it is not newly incurred per-answer expenditure and must not be summed across answers.
measurement_definitions.provider_cost_scope: Provider-reported token use, not currency charges. Local CPU, memory and embedding/reranker/translation work are real but not Step-5 tokens. Agent blind reviews are outside the product-runtime provider call count. Reported reasoning_tokens=0 does not prove no internal reasoning.

limits: Eight questions, one generation per arm, one agent review per pair; results may reflect provider variation and reviewer judgment.
Four famous papers may be present in model pretraining; exact citation-pack support is assessed separately from factual correctness.
No statistical significance, unseen-paper generalization, universal long-term memory, RSI, or deployment-latency claim.
V5 repeats these same questions after V4; retain the fixture split names for traceability, but it is not a fresh held-out test. V5 pre-freeze exposure scope is recorded below.
All questions, negatives and the separate diagnostic are retained. Do not select the best version/question subset or combine different algorithm versions into one quality average.

optional_evidence_selection.rerank_query: best literal or guarded local-translation question facet per candidate

optional_evidence_selection.scope: ON only; OFF preserves the existing hybrid source selector

activation.meaning: All main ON arms changed the selected source pack; no formal auxiliary support item was supplied. Activation alone does not establish improved evidence.

all_provider_consumption.definition: All provider-reported consumption, including failed or truncated attempts. Not currency charges; unknown usage is not zero. Separate from successful matched-pair averages.

setup_actual_totals_ms.definition: Separate measured local work including the diagnostic. Shared corpus ingestion counted once per unique corpus; not a sum of upfront_setup_latency_ms.

v4.interpretation_zh: 总体质量均值提升主要来自准确性和范围表达；关键事实完整性维度均值从2.375降为1.875。较少原文来源与较短输出降低了token/答案耗时，但没有改善严格事实覆盖。V4不能作为可靠检索增强已实现的证据。

pre_freeze_exposure_scope.basis: Run coordinator disclosure recorded after V5 code freeze, not an independently observed audit log.
pre_freeze_exposure_scope.coordinator_before_v5_freeze: Inspected only the four V4 development-regression questions' source packs/results; did not read new-question gold facts, full new answers or their aggregate scores before V5 freeze.
pre_freeze_exposure_scope.v2_code_audit_agent: Read production code and synthetic counterexamples only, no benchmark contents.
pre_freeze_exposure_scope.blind_review_agents: Reviewed the new-question packets but sent only completion counts before V5 freeze.
pre_freeze_exposure_scope.aggregate_timing: The V5 ca8d26988d54ed18b33c9dbfc180f3105551d99bd6da261defcc1c636d30e8a6 runtime was frozen before the coordinator first received V4 aggregate and new-split statistics.
pre_freeze_exposure_scope.v4_new_question_preparation: New questions were authored and checked against the original papers, then the fixture was frozen before V4 calls.
pre_freeze_exposure_scope.claim_limit: The same eight questions and four known papers are reused. Neither the four new-question label nor delayed score exposure makes V5 a new held-out corpus, and V4 plus V5 are not sixteen independent questions.

v5.evaluation_scope: Repeated same eight main questions and one diagnostic, not a newly held-out validation.

off.answer_sentence: 此外，S3 指出 C3 比 TS 少 26–33% 的 context tokens，C0 少超过 97%，说明上下文容量并未保持一致 [S3]。
off.reason: 这是对本题核心实验控制的实质性反转：把处理 token 成本冒充不同上下文容量，断言了并不存在的比较条件。附带原文第 7 页明确六种条件回答窗口相同，仅内容构建不同；第 9 页还说明统一 8k。该句触犯禁止把六条件窗口说成不同的约束，故按关键错误规则将 factual_accuracy 与 scope_and_uncertainty 均置 0。

activation.meaning: All main ON arms changed the selected source pack; no formal auxiliary support item was supplied. Activation alone does not establish improved evidence.

all_provider_consumption.definition: All provider-reported consumption, including failed or truncated attempts. Not currency charges; unknown usage is not zero. Separate from successful matched-pair averages.

diagnostics.interpretation_zh: 纯中文诊断的两侧均调用真实模型并返回evidence回答。ON提供6条来源，区分位置/长度现象、潜在干扰推断与MemGPT记忆机制，承认现有节选不能建立完整因果链；这不是盲评质量胜负或严格召回改善的证据。

critical_error_details.answer_sentence: 此外，S3 指出 C3 比 TS 少 26–33% 的 context tokens，C0 少超过 97%，说明上下文容量并未保持一致 [S3]。
critical_error_details.reason: 这是对本题核心实验控制的实质性反转：把处理 token 成本冒充不同上下文容量，断言了并不存在的比较条件。附带原文第 7 页明确六种条件回答窗口相同，仅内容构建不同；第 9 页还说明统一 8k。该句触犯禁止把六条件窗口说成不同的约束，故按关键错误规则将 factual_accuracy 与 scope_and_uncertainty 均置 0。

major_negative_cases_zh.finding: ON将RAG未来联合预训练建议混入既有设计比较，未取得MemGPT分层记忆/事件函数机制，related-work核心综合不完整。
ON错误地用预训练/预加载或可替换性解释文档编码器冻结，缺少实际训练边界、负边缘对数似然和索引重建成本条件。
ON没有取到RAM/disk映射、跨层函数搬运与continuation/yield规则，回答主要成为缺口清单。
ON仍不完整；OFF把较少处理token误判为不同回答上下文容量，触发关键错误并被降至30分。因此单题大胜不能当作整体稳定改善。

v5.interpretation_zh: 最终V5总体评分下降、严格证据召回下降、来源噪声上升；答案更短更快不能弥补未回答的复合事实和方法错误。新题组的小幅正均值伴随2胜2负，且OFF关键错误使该均值不稳定。

accounting_across_versions.definition: Provider accounting only; currency charges and agent review costs are not included. These are two frozen algorithms on the same eight primary questions, not sixteen independent questions; never pool them as one quality experiment.

off_input_hash_comparison.interpretation: V4 and V5 OFF prompts and supplied source contents are identical for all nine questions. This rules out recorded OFF input drift, not provider-generation variation or blind-reviewer variability.

off_retrieval_annotation_disagreement.interpretation: The same OFF evidence packs received slightly different independent agent annotations. Do not interpret V4-to-V5 strict-recall changes as a calibrated algorithm effect; preserve each run's review and note that inter-rater reliability is unestablished.

cross_version_audit.comparison_rule: The main causal contrast is each run's OFF-versus-ON pair. Across-version means are descriptive only: outputs, reviewer judgments and provider timing can change despite identical OFF inputs. V4 and V5 are not sixteen independent questions.

release_gate.definition: Qualitative deployment recommendation from the full observed quality/evidence results, not a retrospectively invented statistical threshold.

current_application_gate.scope_note: Verified application entry point. ResearchService constructor itself defaults to true; this is not a claim that all direct programmatic uses default OFF.

reasons: V5 overall quality delta is negative and four of eight question pairs lose.
V5 strict source-pack full-fact coverage falls from 9/23 to 6/23, with no fully covered ON question.
Wholly irrelevant source-label noise rises by both micro and macro aggregation.
V4's positive weighted mean did not preserve strict coverage, and V5 does not demonstrate that issue is fixed.
Token and answer-latency savings are measurable but do not authorize quality claims or default activation.

diagnostic_priority.coordinator_read_only_audit: Relevant training/NLL and fixed document-encoder material exists in the corpus and useful parts were supplied by OFF, but the final ON pack omitted them.
diagnostic_priority.localization_limit: The paid trace does not persist every candidate's identity, individual logit and elimination reason. It cannot establish exactly whether the useful training passage was lost at candidate construction, ranking, thresholding or final packing. A full candidate count and a high ranking score do not prove that all required facts or conditions are present.
diagnostic_priority.next_action_scope: First add and inspect layer-by-layer candidate/score/selection diagnostics in a separately authorized follow-up. No further paid calls, benchmark-specific threshold tuning or production changes are part of this audit.

engineering_test_evidence.basis: Coordinator-reported completed test runs; this numerical report did not rerun test suites.
engineering_test_evidence.interpretation: Passing engineering tests supports tested invariants, not empirical answer quality; overlapping targeted runs are not additional independent test counts.

release_gate.next_validation_scope: Investigate missing compound facts and the incorrect RAG/MemGPT evidence before another release claim; use a new frozen question set and preferably new papers, with explicit annotation calibration. This report itself authorizes no new provider calls or code changes.
